detail.longDescription: MCP 2026-07-28 mirrors the JSON-RPC method and tool name into Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name headers so gateways can apply policy without parsing bodies. That is safe only if the server behind it rejects a header that contradicts the body (400, code -32020). Older versions never check, so a gateway must pin MCP-Protocol-Version before trusting either. The spec says SHOULD. https:// modelcontextprotocol.io/specif ication/2026-07-28/basic/transports/streamable-http # MCP # AIAgents # APISecurity
